summary:
Flux Mars is an interactive 3D Mars survival simulation inspired by the challenges of establishing a sustainable human presence on Mars. Players take the role of astronauts who must survive after an emergency landing and restore an abandoned Martian outpost.

The game combines exploration, resource management, base repair, and scientific decision-making. Players can repair a greenhouse, prepare soil, plant crops, manage water and energy, and use an autonomous robotic rover called SCOUT-01 to explore the Martian terrain and identify potential ice resources.

Our goal is to make the challenges of living on Mars understandable through an immersive and educational experience. Flux Mars demonstrates how technology, teamwork, resource management, and scientific knowledge could support future human missions to Mars.
details:
Flux Mars is a browser-based 3D survival simulation developed using React, TypeScript, Three.js, and React Three Fiber.

The experience begins with a spacecraft emergency landing on Mars. Players then explore the Martian surface, select an astronaut, and work to restore an abandoned outpost.

The gameplay focuses on realistic survival challenges, including repairing damaged infrastructure, restoring a greenhouse, preparing soil for food production, managing water and electricity, and exploring the environment for resources.

An autonomous robotic companion, SCOUT-01, assists the astronaut by exploring terrain, scanning the surroundings, and helping identify potential ice deposits.

The project uses 3D environments, interactive gameplay systems, resource management, and scientific concepts to demonstrate some of the challenges future Mars explorers may face.

We developed the project with React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, and 3D models and assets. We considered performance optimization to make the experience accessible on standard Windows laptops.

Flux Mars aims to turn complex space exploration challenges into an engaging educational experience.
